svg.title: frootlab wordmark logo system and its variants
svg.desc: Five panels: the primary lockup with the frootlab wordmark over a six-segment Calvert gold and black rule ending in a red cross bottony node, with a descriptive subline; a compact header version without the subline; a single-ink version where alternating rule segments are outlined instead of gold; a stacked centred version with the cross bottony above the wordmark; and a favicon mark showing the cross bottony in a red rounded tile at 48, 32 and 16 pixels.
svg.text: one ink, for print and dark grounds
favicon mark from the terminator node
